method: Each group is compared with its own department's doctorates in this site's thesis record: same admissions, same funding, same applicant pool. The p-value is the exact binomial probability of seeing at least this many marked names in a group this size if it drew at the department's rate.
why_corrected: This list was assembled by CRAWLING, not by being given names. 83 groups were tested, so an uncorrected table would show roughly one in twenty as unusual with nothing unusual happening. Benjamini-Hochberg at q controls the false discovery rate across the whole set: of the groups called significant here, about q of them are expected to be ordinary.
not_a_why: This says how unusual a composition is. It does not say why, and this site does not offer one. A group recruits from who applies, from collaborators, from a shared language, from a technique taught in few places.
name_markers: A classifier reading names cannot know citizenship, birthplace or nationality, and many Americans have names it marks. The share is of NAMES CARRYING A MARKER and nothing more.
population_source: US Census Bureau, American Community Survey: about 5.5 million people of Chinese origin alone or in combination, in a population of about 335 million.
